description: Early blight detected, heavy rain expected in 24h

expected.action: Wait until rain clears, then spray — do not skip treatment

notes: Spraying before rain wastes the treatment; delay is not the same as ignoring the disease

description: Storm risk to standing crop, prices currently rising

expected.action: Harvest early to protect crop from storm; note price is trending up

notes: Spoiled crop earns nothing — crop protection outweighs price optimization

expected.action: Treat the crop first — untreated disease compounds losses faster than a price dip

notes: Early/moderate infection still salvageable; treating protects both yield and eventual sale value

description: Drought stress on crop, price signal says sell now

expected.action: Irrigate/protect crop if not yet ready for harvest — price advice assumes a harvestable crop exists

notes: Price signal is meaningless if drought prevents a harvestable crop from existing

description: Mild early-stage disease, favorable weather, hold on price

expected.action: Continue monitoring crop; no urgent action needed

notes: Deliberately non-conflicting case — tests the table does not over-trigger a conflict flag

description: Healthy crop, drought risk, neutral price

expected.action: Irrigate due to drought risk — no disease/price conflict involved

notes: Tests single-agent advice surfacing correctly even when only one agent has a strong signal

description: Disease needs treatment, drought stress, price says hold

expected.action: Treat disease immediately (fastest-compounding risk); irrigate if feasible; price trend is secondary info

notes: Three-way pull resolved by ranking urgency: disease > drought > price

description: Disease needs treatment, weather forecast unclear

expected.action: Treat now with a caution note about unclear weather — do not wait indefinitely for forecast clarity

notes: Tests handling of the uncertain weather state — disease urgency should not be blocked by forecast ambiguity

description: Mild disease, rain risk, good sell price

expected.action: Harvest now to capture price and avoid rain damage; treatment can wait since disease is mild

notes: Mild disease + rain + good price all point toward harvesting now rather than treating

description: Severe disease, favorable weather, sell price good

expected.action: Treat now — favorable weather is actually the best spray window available

notes: Apparent conflict resolves into synergy once reasoned through; tests the table can detect false-alarm conflicts

description: Healthy crop, storm risk, price says hold

expected.action: Check harvest readiness and protect crop from storm; price optimization is secondary

notes: A storm can undo a healthy crop instantly — protection takes priority over price timing

description: Mild disease, uncertain weather, neutral price — all low-signal

expected.action: Advise the farmer that guidance is uncertain here; suggest confirming with a local agriculture officer

notes: Deliberate edge case with no strong signal from any agent — exercises the catch-all unresolved-conflict fallback
